21.3.solution: DELETE FROM temoignages_bruts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(temoin)) ORDER BY recu_le, id) AS rn FROM temoignages_bruts) WHERE rn > 1);

Structure : DELETE FROM temoignages_bruts WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (...) AS rn FROM temoignages_bruts) WHERE rn > 1);

21.4.solution: SELECT UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(plaque), ' ', ''), '-', '')) AS plaque, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM temoignages_bruts WHERE TRIM(plaque) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(plaque), ' ', ''), '-', '')) ORDER BY nb DESC;

Structure : SELECT UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(plaque), ' ', ''), '-', '')) AS plaque, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM ... WHERE TRIM(plaque) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY (même expression) ORDER BY nb DESC;
21.4.note: Piège Oracle : '' est NULL, une comparaison avec '' ne renvoie jamais vrai. TRIM d'une plaque faite d'espaces donne NULL, d'où le test IS NOT NULL. GROUP BY 1 (position) n'est pas activé par défaut.
